parameters.query: select (select email from ttw.sessions where token_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to($1, 'UTF8')), 'hex') and expires_at > now() limit 1) as email

select (select id from ttw.generations where $1 <> '' and idem_key = $1 and lower(email) = lower($2)) as existing_id, exists (select 1 from ttw.generations where lower(email) = lower($2) and (free_use_consumed or (status in ('queued', 'running') and created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'))) as used

insert into ttw.ip_attempts (ip_hash, day, count) values (encode(sha256(convert_to($1, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), current_date, 1) on conflict (ip_hash, day) do update set count = ttw.ip_attempts.count + 1 where ttw.ip_attempts.count < $2::int returning count, ip_hash
insert into ttw.daily_budget (day) values (current_date) on conflict (day) do nothing
update ttw.daily_budget set reserved_usd = reserved_usd + $1::numeric where day = current_date and spent_usd + reserved_usd + $1::numeric <= $2::numeric returning day, reserved_usd, spent_usd
update ttw.daily_budget set reserved_usd = greatest(reserved_usd - $1::numeric, 0) where day = current_date returning reserved_usd

with o as (select id, reserved_usd as r, created_at::date as d from ttw.generations where id = $1 and status in ('queued', 'running') for update), g as (update ttw.generations t set status = 'failed', error = $2, reserved_usd = 0, cost_usd = $3::numeric from o where t.id = o.id returning t.id), b as (update ttw.daily_budget bb set reserved_usd = greatest(bb.reserved_usd - o.r, 0), spent_usd = bb.spent_usd + $3::numeric from o where bb.day = o.d returning 1) select (select count(*) from g)::int as failed, (select count(*) from b)::int as released

with o as (select id, reserved_usd as r, created_at::date as d from ttw.generations where id = $1 and status in ('queued', 'running') for update), g as (update ttw.generations t set status = 'failed', error = $2, reserved_usd = 0, cost_usd = $3::numeric from o where t.id = o.id returning t.id), b as (update ttw.daily_budget bb set reserved_usd = greatest(bb.reserved_usd - o.r, 0), spent_usd = bb.spent_usd + $3::numeric from o where bb.day = o.d returning 1) select (select count(*) from g)::int as failed, (select count(*) from b)::int as released
update ttw.generations set status = 'running' where id = $1 and status = 'queued' returning id

parameters.query: with o as (select id, reserved_usd as r, created_at::date as d from ttw.generations where id = $1 and status = 'running' for update), g as (update ttw.generations t set status = 'done', error = null, result_path_45 = $2, result_path_916 = $3, cost_usd = $4::numeric, free_use_consumed = true, reserved_usd = 0 from o where t.id = o.id returning t.id), b as (update ttw.daily_budget bb set reserved_usd = greatest(bb.reserved_usd - o.r, 0), spent_usd = bb.spent_usd + $4::numeric, generations_count = bb.generations_count + 1 from o where bb.day = o.d returning 1) select (select count(*) from g)::int as done, (select count(*) from b)::int as budget_rows

with o as (select id, reserved_usd as r, created_at::date as d from ttw.generations where error = 'exec:' || $1 and status in ('queued', 'running') for update), g as (update ttw.generations t set status = 'failed', error = 'server', reserved_usd = 0, cost_usd = $2::numeric from o where t.id = o.id returning t.id), b as (update ttw.daily_budget bb set reserved_usd = greatest(bb.reserved_usd - o.r, 0), spent_usd = bb.spent_usd + $2::numeric from o where bb.day = o.d returning 1) select (select count(*) from g)::int as failed

parameters.query: with o as (select id, reserved_usd as r, created_at::date as d from ttw.generations where id = $1 and status in ('queued', 'running') and created_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' for update), g as (update ttw.generations t set status = 'failed', error = 'server', reserved_usd = 0 from o where t.id = o.id returning t.id), b as (update ttw.daily_budget bb set reserved_usd = greatest(bb.reserved_usd - o.r, 0) from o where bb.day = o.d and o.r > 0 returning 1) select (select json_build_object('status', case when exists (select 1 from g) then 'failed' else t.status end, 'error', case when exists (select 1 from g) then 'server' else t.error end, 'post', t.result_path_45, 'story', t.result_path_916) from ttw.generations t where t.id = $1 and t.expires_at > now()) as r, (select count(*) from b)::int as released
